connectors.form: DB25 cable named in legacy V90 motor/driver-kit guide; connector ends and mating view unspecified
connectors.scope: Reference-only optional motor/driver kit described by the Probotix V90 guide. The MakeICT retired V90 is not shown to have this kit. The guide says the kit includes a DB25 cable and separately says a complete machine needs a PC with a parallel port; it gives no DB25 pin functions, connector-end direction, board revision, or fitted-machine correspondence. The 25 numbered entries below are nominal DB25 positions only, not an electrical pinout. This is an external peripheral endpoint beside the SmoothieBox; every contact is OPEN and no route is assigned.
